accounts.title: Amazon Buyer Accounts
accounts.subtitle: Manage your Amazon buyer accounts for order tracking and price scraping
accounts.noAccountsDescription: Add your Amazon buyer account to automatically track order prices and shipping status
accounts.deleteConfirmMessage: Are you sure you want to delete this Amazon account? This action cannot be undone.
accounts.twoFactorInfo: If you have 2FA enabled, enter the secret key from your Amazon account security settings
accounts.verifyFailed: Failed to verify Amazon account. Please check your credentials.

linking.title: Link Amazon Order
linking.orderIdHelp: Enter your Amazon order ID (found in your order history or confirmation email)
linking.successMessage: Order details have been scraped and linked successfully
linking.errorNoAccount: Please add an Amazon account first
linking.errorScraping: Could not scrape Amazon order details. Please check the order ID and try again.
linking.errorInvalidCredentials: Amazon credentials are invalid. Please update your account.
linking.errorRateLimit: Too many requests. Please try again later.
linking.costCaptureFailed: Amazon order was found but the cost details couldn't be read. Profit kept at last known value.
linking.noAccountsMessage: You need to add an Amazon buyer account first to link orders.

autoFulfill.autoFulfillEnabledHint: When on, matching eBay orders are automatically purchased through this Amazon account (round-robin with your other enabled accounts). The master Auto-Fulfillment toggle in Store Settings must also be on, and a spend cap must be set below.
autoFulfill.autoFulfillCapTotalHint: Per-account spend ceiling (USD). Orders above this total skip this account. Required to enable auto-fulfillment.
autoFulfill.autoFulfillDryRun: Dry-run (run the flow without placing the order)
autoFulfill.autoFulfillDryRunHint: Runs the full checkout flow up to (not including) Place Order so the review total can be captured and surfaced for review.

proxy.stepSubtitle: Optional — route this account's automation through your own proxy
proxy.enabledHint: Use a proxy server to protect your account
proxy.hint: Optional. Add your own proxy to route this account's automation through it — helpful if you want extra protection against IP-based blocks. Leave it off and the account connects directly; that's the normal default.

marketplace.label: Marketplace
marketplace.usOnlyNote: Only the United States (amazon.com) marketplace is supported at this time.
marketplace.readOnlyHint: Marketplace can't be changed after the account is created.

errors.autoFulfillCapRequired: Set a max order total to enable auto-fulfillment on this account.
errors.proxyHostPortRequired: Enter a host and port to use a proxy for this account.
errors.unsupportedMarketplace: This Amazon marketplace isn't available yet.
errors.twoFactorSecretRequired: Add the account's authenticator (2FA) secret key. Amazon requires a verification code on almost every automated sign-in, and this is the only one we can answer for you.
errors.twoFactorSecretInvalid: That doesn't look like an authenticator secret key. Paste the setup key from Amazon's authenticator-app setup (letters A–Z and digits 2–7), not a 6-digit code.
